title: PlannerOutput
description: Output contract for the Planner agent. Defines the full DAG as a list of Work Units.

session_id.description: The session slug this plan belongs to.

work_units.title: Implement image storage service
work_units.description: Create a local file-based image store with upload and retrieve operations.
acceptance_criteria: POST /images saves the file to disk and returns a UUID
GET /images/{id} returns the file or 404 if not found

work_units.title: Wire up FastAPI routes
work_units.description: Create the FastAPI app and connect the routes to the storage service.
acceptance_criteria: GET / returns 200 with a JSON health check
POST /images and GET /images/{id} delegate to storage.py

id.description: Zero-padded Work Unit identifier, e.g. WU-001.

description.description: Full description of what needs to be done.

acceptance_criteria.description: Ordered list of AC statements. Each line of code must trace back to one of these.

solution_domain.description: Exhaustive list of file paths this WU is expected to create or modify. Used for domain overlap checks.

dependencies.description: IDs of WUs that must be completed before this one can start.
